name: weather
title: Weather
description: Current local weather from Open-Meteo, with no account or key. The bar stays out of the way in ordinary weather and shows up for rain, fog, wind or uncomfortable temperatures.
author: pal

settings.label: Location
settings.description: A place name, optionally narrowed by region or country: “Istanbul”, “London, Ontario”, “Paris, Texas”. Only the first part is searched; the rest choose between same-named places. Resolved privately by Open-Meteo's location search.

weather.title: Weather
weather.description: Current temperature, condition, feels-like temperature, humidity and wind for the configured place.

temp.description: The temperature now, in the service's unit

quiet.description: A clear or cloudy sky (WMO 0 to 3): nothing falling, no fog

weather.title: Weather
weather.description: A quiet condition-led weather signal: hidden by its rules in ordinary weather (a quiet sky between 10 and 30 degrees), visible for rain, fog, wind or temperatures outside that band, blue when cold and red when hot. The popover is the forecast: the reading now with feels-like, humidity, wind and rain, the next eight hours from this one, then four days of high, low and the chance of rain, with sunrise and sunset.

rules.description: A quiet sky inside the comfort band: off the strip (move the band here).

store.tagline: Local weather on the bar, only when it is worth noticing
